caption.text:
Women’s College Hospital’s clinical extern posting closes Nov 20, 2026: BScN, BCLS required, $20.60/hr, up to 7.5 hours per week (as posted). SHN’s clinical nurse extern talent pool closes Nov 30 ($25.379/hr, BScN year three or final year, BCLS required). Full requirements are on each hospital’s posting.

Every open Ontario extern posting I can check on hospitals’ own career pages: ontarioexterns.ca (independent, not affiliated with any hospital).
